notes.title: Thunder Helix v0.620 Released
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce a new update for Thunder Helix. It combines a large number of smaller changes. 

Also, in case you missed it, Thunder Helix is now verified for Steam Deck!

The full list of changes can be found on the Discussions page:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1906230/discussions/0/3183485686831344030/?ctp=2#c601905642111798413

notes.title: Thunder Helix v0.610 Released
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm happy to release this first part of updates to improve controller support in Thunder Helix.

The main change you will notice is the addition of an information bar in all non-gameplay "front-end" interface screens. This will list the inputs available for that screen with appropriate controller buttons (or keyboard keys) shown.

In addition a serious crash bug has been detected and resolved. Certain systems were experiencing crash-to-desktop errors on startup caused by the Windows MME sub-system. Thunder Helix was using this, in part, to support joysticks. This has been removed, leaving the more common DirectInput and XInput APIs still available. It is not expected that existing working controllers will stop working. Please report this on the discussion forum if that happens. Apologies for any inconvenience caused.

A further controller update is planned for the future.

- Enjoy!

notes.title: Thunder Helix v0.609 Released
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm pleased to present a new update for Thunder Helix.

This update adds a new randomized combat scenario "Alpha Strike" in which you must destroy an enemy target deep within the heart of the desert - then make it home again!

The update also contains a number of improvements and bug fixes.

- Enjoy !

notes.title: Thunder Helix v0.608 Released
notes.notes:
Hello again! I'm happy to present a new update for Thunder Helix.

This update adds a new [i]randomized[/i] scenario mission "Crash Rescue" in which you must pick up survivors. Along the way you'll encounter deadly enemy forces, ready to take you down too!

Stay tuned for more mission updates in future!

- Enjoy !

notes.title: Thunder Helix v0.607 Released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm pleased to release this new update to Thunder Helix. 

The main addition is a new scenario "Tornado!" in which you must evacuate a chain of islands while avoiding a deadly tropical storm. It will be a difficult task, good luck!

Here's a list of other changes in this update:

[added] Ability to have an additional passenger holding onto the ladder, if the aircraft is at capacity.
[added] Quick exit the waypoint/nav MFD page when target selection keys are pressed.
[added] Lewis chain-gun aiming position is shown on the HUD.
[added] Itemise destroyed helicopters on the Pilot Stats. screen.
[added] Direction arrow for the player on the area map screen.
[added] Loading screen before briefing to cover mission generation/setup time.
[added] Additional lighting to runways and control towers at night.

[changed] Limit the pitch range of the pilot's head to always keep the horizon visible.
[changed] Allow the left analog stick of a controller / Steam Deck to navigate menus.
[changed] Renamed all gun mounted trucks in the campaign to show as a 'Technical'.
[changed] Remember the last page when returning to the map screen.
[changed] Adjust the maximum map zoom level to ensure the whole map can be visible.
[changed] Removed the graphics option to disable clouds.
[changed] Steam Deck: Remove input mode selection on startup.
[changed] Steam Deck: Never display a mouse pointer.
[changed] Tweak to bring the 'dot' distance of people closer, to avoid aliasing.
[changed] Tweak position of HUD message lines when in-cockpit.
[changed] Recolored and simplified the jet mesh.

[fixed] Map scrolling snaps to whole pixels. Fixes shimmering when using the mouse.
[fixed] Map scrolling with mouse could cancel unexpectedly after zooming.
[fixed] Water ripple colours now match ocean/lakes correctly in 256 colour mode.

- Enjoy!

notes.title: Thunder Helix v0.603 Released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is my first update to Thunder Helix since release last week. It fixes a number of issues, and adds a new cockpit look left/right feature.

Here's a full list of changes since release!
[code][added] Can now look left/right in cockpit. See control reference PDF for details.
[added] Cockpit HUD now shows an additional circle which indicates the aiming direction of the Raven cannon and Avenger chin-gun.
[added] Show version number on the front-end and in-game Options>Mission page.
[fixed] Horizon line didn't extend to the screen edges in 0.5 zoom mode.
[changed] Minor tweaks to the volume control UI.
[fixed] Improved aiming of the Raven cannon to match the HUD center point.
[added] Full-screen toggle <F11> option on Options>Graphics menu.
[added] Mention <F11> to toggle full-screen on the graphics mode select screen.
[changed] Improved navigation of the Graphics and Sound options menus.
[added] "Sound Enabled" option on Options>Sound to disable all audio.
[added] Mouse flight options sub-menu.
[added] Option to mouse control the external camera in mouse flight mode.
[fixed] Allow mouse wheel to zoom camera in mouse flight mode.
[changed] Darker HUD in day missions when using EGA colour mode.
[fixed] By default use Windows 'main' monitor, not monitor #1.
[added] Restart option for the in-game Mission options menu.
[added] Flight time stats are now itemised for each helicopter.
[added] Store per-vehicle win counts for each mission.
[added] ammo usage is tracked in the profile and shown on the stats page.
[/code]
